text:
sanjay: morning — quick follow-up from the 0300 region blip. root cause looks like an out-of-sync token rotation policy on the vendor side, which combined with our aggressive refresh window caused a brief spike of 401s. put owners/timelines below.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-501 created by sanjay — vendor token rotation mismatch -> regional 401s. priority: P2.

elaine: need short-term blast-radius reduction + medium-term hardening. list owners please.

ken: short-term: increase client-side acceptance skew (+30s) and add jittered refresh; feature flag to roll in 24h. owner: ken. due: +1d.

ash: routing: add temporary regional holdback so eu-west can fall back to eu-north if 401 rate > 1% for 2m. owner: ash. due: +2d.

maria: monitoring: add metric for token-refresh failures and a synthetic that exercises rotation every 10m; wire to eng-oncall after 2 fails. owner: maria. due: +2d.

tim: vendor comms: requesting their rotation schedule and asking for a coordinated change window. will push for notification hooks. owner: tim. vendor call: Thu 1500 UTC.

kate: I'll draft an incident notice template for customers and partners; low-risk wording. owner: kate. due: +1d.

acme-sre: we observed an unexpected drift in rotation timestamps in eu-west pool. we'll backfill correlation logs and share a proposed patch by Thu.

sanjay: action list consolidated: 
- T1: Client acceptance skew + jittered refresh (ken) — DUE +1d
- T2: Regional holdback failover gating (ash) — DUE +2d
- T3: Rotation-aware synthetic + dashboard (maria) — DUE +2d
- T4: Vendor rotation schedule + notification hooks (tim) — Vendor call Thu 1500 UTC
- T5: Customer incident notice draft (kate) — DUE +1d
- T6: Add monthly recurrence in tracker to spot rotation pattern regressions (sanjay) — DUE +3d

ken: small pseudo for jittered refresh: 
```\nif (expires_in < jitter_window + rand(0, jitter_max)) {\n  refresh_token_with_backoff()\n}\n```
PR coming — will be feature-flagged.

maria: synthetic will rotate a test token via the vendor API then attempt a model pull. will simulate 429/401 to ensure fallbacks.

ash: holdback will be a short-lived route weight change with a warmup period to let caches settle. will auto-rollback on increased 5xxs.

tim: vendor asked for our spike traces; I dropped a link in the doc. also asked them to include expected rotation window in their RCA notes.

op-bot: Reminder — tag: vendor:acme, subsystem:auth, impact:regional.

sanjay: checkpoints: Wed EOD internal status, Thu vendor call, next Mon closure review. i'll add tasks to the mitigation tracker and set weekly recurrence. ping me to reassign.

kate: notice draft uploaded — please review.

acme-sre: we'll share correlation logs before Thu and propose a patch for rotation alignment.

elaine: agreed on checkpoints. adding circuit-breaker consideration if 401s cascade in the future (owner: elaine). due +5d.

ken: opened PR #4399 for jittered refresh + flag. requesting review from @maria @ash.

maria: wiring synthetic to ops dashboard now. will handover pager links to eng-oncall.

sanjay: thanks team — i'll update the tracker and follow up after the vendor call. :thumbsup:
